title: Shared vs Exclusive Leads: The Per-Booked-Job Math
h1: Shared vs Exclusive Leads: The Per-Booked-Job Math
meta: A 'cheap' shared lead is a bidding war; an 'expensive' exclusive lead is a real conversation. Why exclusive is often cheaper per booked job (Lead Connect 2026).
short: A cheap shared lead is sold to a pack of pros and won on price. An expensive exclusive lead is only yours and won on value. Run it per booked job and the 'expensive' one is often the cheaper one.
statLabel: Of homeowners hire whoever responds first — which is why shared leads are a race (Lead Connect 2026)

body.answer: Cheap-and-shared is a race; pricier-and-exclusive is a conversation.
body.html: Shared leads are sold to a pack of pros, so you win them by being fastest and cheapest. Exclusive leads are only yours, so you win them by being good. Per booked job, 'good' usually costs less than 'fastest and cheapest.'

body.answer: Shared leads turn every job into a bidding war.
body.html: When a homeowner submits a shared lead, five phones ring in ten minutes. You've been entered into a price war before you've said a word, and 78% hire whoever responds first (Lead Connect 2026). You either drop your price or lose. Neither builds a business.

body.answer: No competition on the line means you sell on value.
body.html: An exclusive lead — from your Google profile, your site, a referral — is a real conversation. No one else is on the call, so you can diagnose, build trust, and price for margin instead of survival. Higher close rate, higher ticket, calmer business.

body.answer: This one came straight off the podcast.
body.html: Marshall and Ray went deep on this in Cost Per Lead vs Cost Per Booked Job on Get Booked, Not F***ed — same math, more cussing. Watch or listen to the full episode here.

faq.q: Are shared leads or exclusive leads better?
faq.a: Per booked job, exclusive leads are usually cheaper despite a higher sticker price. Shared leads are a price race — 78% of homeowners hire whoever responds first (Lead Connect 2026).

faq.q: Why is a cheap lead expensive?
faq.a: A cheap shared lead is sold to several pros and won on price, so your close rate and margin both drop. Cost per booked job, not cost per lead, reveals it.

faq.q: Where do exclusive leads come from?
faq.a: Your Google Business Profile, a website that converts, and a referral system — leads that are only yours and don't vanish when you stop paying.
